recent_articles.title: Rajya Sabha polls: Congress delegation meets ECI over rejection of Meenakshi Natarajan’s nomination - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A **Congress** delegation, including general secretary K.C. Venugopal and candidate Meenakshi Natarajan, met with the **Election Commission of India (ECI)** on Wednesday to address the rejection of her nomination for Rajya Sabha polls in Madhya Pradesh.  **Mr. Singhvi**, a member of the delegation, argued that the court notice was based on a private complaint and not a criminal case, and requested the commission to withdraw the order of rejection. The party president **Mallikarjun Kharge** convened an urgent meeting for Congress leaders to discuss the situation.

recent_articles.title: Rajya Sabha polls: Congress delegation meets ECI over rejection of Meenakshi Natarajan’s nomination - The Hindu

Venugopal** and candidate **Meenakshi Natarajan**, met with the **Election Commission of India (ECI)** on Wednesday to address the rejection of **Natarajan's** nomination for Rajya Sabha polls in Madhya Pradesh. The party president, **Mallikarjun Kharge**, convened an urgent meeting to discuss the situation.

recent_articles.title: Meenakshi Natarajan's Nomination Scrapped, Congress Explores Legal Options
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** leaders protested outside the **Election Commission** headquarters in Delhi after the rejection of their Rajya Sabha candidate, **Meenakshi Natarajan**,'s nomination papers.  The **Election Commission** acknowledged the Congress memorandum and is expected to seek a report from the Returning Officer over the controversy. Senior Congress leaders, including KC Venugopal, Jairam Ramesh, Sachin Pilot, and Bhupesh Baghel, staged a protest, while sources say the party is preparing for a legal challenge against the rejection.

recent_articles.title: Congress-JMM Seat Share Plan For Rajya Sabha Polls: Here's How They Can Win
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Hemant Soren** and the **Jharkhand Mukti Morcha (JMM)** have finalized a seat-sharing agreement for two Rajya Sabha seats in Jharkhand.  **Hemant Soren** agreed to concede one seat to the **Congress**, with the party's candidate being Pranav Jha. The deal was reached after discussions between **Hemant Soren** and Congress observers Bhupesh Baghel and Ajay Sharma, who met with him on Sunday morning. The JMM has nominated Baijnath Ram for the elections.

recent_articles.title: Congress Rahul Gandhi Priyanka Gandhi: With Eye On Upcoming Polls, Congress Plans Major Organisational Reshuffle
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following the appointment of DK Shivakumar as Chief Minister of Karnataka, **BK Hariprasad** has been named the state Congress president.  The Congress is planning a major reshuffle across over six states, with a focus on poll-bound regions like Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Punjab, Goa, Manipur, Gujarat, and Himachal Pradesh. The party is considering replacing in-charges and state presidents to attract voters and balance caste dynamics. This reshuffle is expected to be the last major one under **Mallikarjun Kharge**'s leadership as Congress president.

recent_articles.title: Exclusive With DK Shivakumar's Daughter, Brother After Big Karnataka Oath
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **DK Shivakumar**, the newly sworn-in Chief Minister of Karnataka, faces high expectations from his family and the public. **Rahul Gandhi** urged focus on upcoming elections in 2028 and 2029, while Shivakumar's daughter Aisshwarya DKS Hegde emphasized a commitment to returning to power in future elections.  Shivakumar has already initiated plans for Bengaluru infrastructure improvements, building regularization, and free student bus rides.

recent_articles.title: Madhya Pradesh MLA Pritam Lodhi Praises Chambal Dacoit Rambabu Gadariya, Calls Him Companions In Happiness, Sorrow
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A **BJP MLA** in Madhya Pradesh, Pritam Lodhi, publicly honored the late dacoit Rambabu Gadariya at a function commemorating the birth anniversary of Lokmata Ahilyabai Holkar.  Lodhi praised Gadariya as a close associate who supported him during difficult times and claimed that he was forced into crime due to societal harassment. This has sparked controversy as Gadariya was one of Chambal's most notorious criminals, facing over 100 criminal cases, including murder and robbery. The event drew thousands of attendees, with Lodhi even placing a photograph of Gadariya alongside the portrait of Ahilyabai Holkar.

recent_articles.title: How Municipal Poll Setback Brought Congress Factionalism To Fore In Punjab
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Congress** suffered a disappointing performance in the Punjab municipal elections, losing to the ruling **Aam Aadmi Party**. This setback has reignited concerns about leadership within the party and fueled internal power struggles. Several senior leaders are positioning themselves for key organizational roles ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections.  While the high command has stated there will be no immediate organizational changes, factionalism remains a significant challenge for the party as it seeks to address accountability and build unity for future electoral success.

recent_articles.title: Punjab Congress to release ‘chargesheet’ against AAP government - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Bhupesh Baghel**, former **Chhattisgarh** Chief Minister and Congress General Secretary in charge of Punjab, presided over a meeting of the state party unit to discuss the "grim state of affairs" under the ruling **AAP** government. The meeting focused on allegations of rampant corruption and deteriorating law and order, leading to feelings of insecurity among residents.  The **Congress** plans to hold "yatras" across all 117 Assembly segments in the coming days to engage with voters and address their concerns.

recent_articles.title: Congress petitions Election Commission to cancel Assam CM’s candidature over ‘undisclosed assets’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Himanta Biswa Sarma**, the Chief Minister of Assam, is facing a petition from the **Assam Congress** to cancel his candidacy for the upcoming Assembly election. The petition alleges that he failed to disclose his wife's alleged offshore assets in his affidavit, violating the Representation of the People Act, 1951. A delegation led by former Chhattisgarh Chief Minister **Bhupesh Baghel** submitted the complaint to the Assam Chief Electoral Officer.  Sarma denies the allegations.

recent_articles.title: Chaitanya Baghel case: Supreme Court to hear question of law; ED maintains case is infructuous - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court of India** agreed to hear a case regarding the ability of investigating agencies to stall trial proceedings by continuing investigations indefinitely. The petition, filed by Chaitanya Baghel, son of former Chhattisgarh Chief Minister Bhupesh Baghel, argues that such actions infringe on his right to bail.  The **ED**, representing the government, argued that the case was now infructuous as Mr. Baghel is already out on bail. The case involves allegations of a ₹2,000 crore liquor scam in Chhattisgarh between 2019 and 2022.

recent_articles.title: ‘BJP diluting rural job scheme’: Chhattisgarh Cong. stages protest - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Congress** party staged a gherao of the Chhattisgarh Assembly on Tuesday, protesting changes to the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA) implemented by the **BJP-led Central government**.  **Sachin Pilot**, AICC general secretary in-charge of Chhattisgarh, accused the **Modi government** of weakening the scheme and taking away decision-making authority from local bodies. **Bhupesh Baghel**, former Chief Minister of Chhattisgarh, also criticized the changes, claiming they would deprive people of their rights and entitlements.
